emotional_tone: Premium, tangible, precise, trustworthy, and visually quiet so the imagery speaks.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-[1.1] font-bold text-text_primary
rules.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-semibold text-text_primary

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. The UI is a frame for the materials. Use p-8 to p-12 for containers.

header.style: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, sticky z-50, border-b border-black/5

cards.style: bg-white border border-black/5 rounded-2xl shadow-soft hover:shadow-hover transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary_foreground hover:bg-black/80 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border border-black/10 hover:bg-black/5 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

inputs_and_uploads.drag_drop_zone: border-2 border-dashed border-black/10 rounded-2xl bg-surface_muted/50 hover:bg-surface_muted transition-colors flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 min-h-[240px]
inputs_and_uploads.standard_input: bg-white border border-black/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all

tags.style: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-tag_bg text-tag_text

motion.list_stagger: Use framer-motion staggerChildren: 0.1 for loading material cards
motion.hover_effects: Transform -translate-y-1 on cards, subtle scale 1.05 on images inside overflow-hidden wrappers

landing_page.hero: Center-aligned content over the abstract_background, or a split 50/50 with the hero_3d_composition on the right. Massive typography. Clear CTA to 'Start Matching'.
landing_page.workflow: 3-step grid. Very minimal icons (use lucide-react with stroke-width 1.5). Large numbering.
landing_page.pricing: 2-column bento style, not traditional rigid pricing tables.

dashboard.layout: Welcome header with user name. A grid of 'Recent Projects' using the interior_reference images as thumbnails. A floating action button or prominent card to 'Upload New Project'.

new_project.layout: Simple modal or clean focused page. Form inputs for Project Name, Client, Notes. Standardized input design.

upload_page.layout: Two massive drag-and-drop zones side-by-side or stacked. 1) Reference Inspiration Image. 2) Catalogue PDF / Product Images. Add a text area for an optional prompt (e.g., 'Prefer sustainable materials'). Include a simulated loading state (mocked) for AI Analysis.

analysis_results.layout: Bento Grid (lg:grid-cols-12). Left column (col-span-4): Sticky container showing the uploaded reference image, tags, and summary. Right column (col-span-8): Grid of extracted materials showing thumbnail, name, match percentage (e.g., 94%), and a short 'Why it matches' explanation. Use the material_wood_stone images for mock results.

report_page.layout: Print-optimized view. Very stark, monochrome feel with high-res images. A 'Download PDF' button at the top right. Hide sidebars/nav when in print mode.

instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use pure Tailwind classes. Inject the Fontshare import into index.css. Do NOT use standard Shadcn Card component if it restricts layout, build custom divs with the exact shadow/border rules provided.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='upload-reference-image', data-testid='start-analysis-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react for all iconography. Keep stroke-width at 1.5 or 1.25 for a more delicate, architectural feel.
instructions_to_main_agent.mocking: Since this is an MVP without a real backend AI yet, MOCK the AI analysis flow with a setTimeout loading screen that transitions to the Analysis Results page after 3 seconds. Use the provided unsplash material urls as the 'matched products'.
